title: TCS Sydney Marathon Presented by ASICS – results, World Athletics
claims: World Athletics lists the TCS Sydney Marathon Presented by ASICS in Sydney, Australia on 30 August 2026.
The men's marathon final places Addisu Gobena first in 2:04:42, Chimdessa Debele second in 2:04:46 and Tebello Ramakongoana third in 2:04:57.
The women's marathon final places Peres Jepchirchir first in 2:18:31, Irine Chepet Cheptai second in 2:22:11 and Shure Demise third in 2:22:33.
The results page lists a men's field including Alphonce Felix Simbu fourth in 2:04:57 and Jemal Mekonen fifth in 2:04:59.
The results page lists a women's field including Ellie Pashley ninth in 2:28:28 and Milly Clark eleventh in 2:29:47.
